items.title: Self-Distillation Enables Continual Learning
items.title_zh: 自蒸馏实现持续学习
items.summary: The authors introduce Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT), which uses a demonstration-conditioned model as its own teacher to generate on-policy training signals without explicit reward functions. Across skill-learning and knowledge-acquisition tasks it reportedly outperforms supervised fine-tuning, with higher new-task accuracy and substantially less catastrophic forgetting, and it lets one model accumulate multiple skills sequentially without regression.

items.title: JAF: Judge Agent Forest
items.title_zh: JAF：评审智能体森林
items.summary: JAF is a framework in which a judge agent performs joint inference across a cohort of query-response pairs from a primary agent, rather than evaluating responses in isolation, so cross-instance patterns can feed back into improvement. It can be instantiated through in-context learning and uses a learned locality-sensitive hashing scheme to select diverse exemplars, validated on cloud misconfiguration triage.

items.title: Qwen3-Max-Thinking
items.title_zh: Qwen3-Max-Thinking 发布
items.summary: Qwen introduced Qwen3-Max-Thinking on its blog, where the platform also lists chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: DETOUR: An Interactive Benchmark for Dual-Agent Search and Reasoning
items.title_zh: DETOUR：面向双智能体搜索与推理的交互式基准
items.summary: DETOUR is a dual-agent benchmark of 1,011 prompts for tip-of-the-tongue search, in which a primary agent must identify a remembered entity by querying a consistent memory agent. Current state-of-the-art models reportedly reach only 36% accuracy across text, image, audio and video, highlighting weakness in underspecified retrieval.

items.title: Agyn: A Multi-Agent System for Team-Based Autonomous Software Engineering
items.title_zh: Agyn：面向团队式自主软件工程的多智能体系统
items.summary: Agyn models software engineering as an organizational process, assigning specialized agents to coordination, research, implementation and review roles with isolated sandboxes and structured communication. Built for production rather than tuned on SWE-bench, it resolved 72.2% of tasks in a post hoc SWE-bench 500 evaluation, beating single-agent baselines with comparable models.

items.title: RIFT: Reordered Instruction Following Testbed To Evaluate Instruction Following in Singular Multistep Prompt Structures
items.title_zh: RIFT：在单一多步提示结构中评估指令遵循的重排测试平台
items.summary: RIFT uses rephrased Jeopardy! question-answer pairs to compare linear prompts with jumping prompts that preserve content but require non-sequential traversal. Across 10,000 evaluations of six open-source LLMs, accuracy dropped by up to 72% under jumping conditions, with about half of failures traced to instruction-order violations and semantic drift.

items.title: The $\mathbf{P}$-Completeness of Inverted Index Traversal: On the Complexity of Evaluating Boolean Query DAGs
items.title_zh: 倒排索引遍历的 P-完全性：布尔查询 DAG 的求值复杂性
items.summary: The paper formalizes a DAG-based retrieval language and proves that evaluating its Boolean queries over an inverted index is P-complete, exposing worst-case exponential blowup for document-at-a-time evaluation and a universal-scan penalty for term-at-a-time materialization. It introduces ComputePN, a sparsity-aware algorithm with a positive-negative dual representation that bounds evaluation time to O(|Q|·|U_active|).

items.title: FFE-Hallu:Hallucinations in Fixed Figurative Expressions:Benchmark of Idioms and Proverbs in the Persian Language
items.title_zh: FFE-Hallu：波斯语固定比喻表达中的幻觉基准
items.summary: The paper introduces FFEHallu, a 600-instance benchmark for figurative hallucination in Persian idioms and proverbs spanning generation, fabricated-expression detection and English-to-Persian translation. It reports systematic weaknesses across six multilingual LLMs.

items.title: Zero-Shot Stance Detection in the Wild: Dynamic Target Generation and Multi-Target Adaptation
items.title_zh: 野外零样本立场检测：动态目标生成与多目标适配
items.summary: The authors define zero-shot stance detection in the wild with dynamic target generation and multi-target adaptation, aiming to identify multiple target-stance pairs from text without prior target knowledge. On a new Chinese social-media dataset, a two-stage fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B reached a 66.99% comprehensive target-recognition score, while an integrated fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B reached 79.26% stance-detection F1.

items.title: Evolutionary Strategies lead to Catastrophic Forgetting in LLMs
items.title_zh: 进化策略导致大语言模型灾难性遗忘
items.summary: The study analyzes evolutionary strategies (ES) as a gradient-free alternative for training LLMs and finds that ES can approach GRPO on math and reasoning tasks at comparable compute, but with significant forgetting of prior abilities. The authors attribute the difference to ES updates being much less sparse and having orders-of-magnitude larger L2 norm than GRPO updates.

items.title: SCALAR: Quantifying Structural Hallucination, Consistency, and Reasoning Gaps in Materials Foundation Models
items.title_zh: SCALAR：量化材料基础模型中的结构幻觉、一致性与推理差距
items.summary: SCALAR is a benchmark for geometric scale generalization in materials foundation models, using about 100,000 DFT-validated structures from a few atoms to over 18,000 atoms across property prediction, chain-of-thought and inverse retrieval tasks. Experiments reportedly show large model-dependent shifts under explicit reasoning, often reducing hallucination and error but frequently destabilizing consistency or validity.

items.title: Agentic Framework for Epidemiological Modeling
items.title_zh: 流行病学建模的智能体框架
items.summary: EPIAGENT is an agentic framework that synthesizes, calibrates, verifies and refines epidemiological simulators by treating disease progression as iterative program synthesis. A key design choice is an explicit epidemiological flow-graph intermediate representation that enables modular correctness checks before code generation; case studies reportedly show it captures complex growth dynamics and produces consistent counterfactual projections.

items.title: Clause-Internal or Clause-External? Testing Turkish Reflexive Binding in Adapted versus Chain of Thought Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 从句内还是从句外？在适配型与思维链大语言模型中检验土耳其语反身代词约束
items.summary: The study tests whether state-of-the-art LLMs capture Turkish reflexive binding using 100 balanced sentences that pit local against non-local antecedents for kendi and kendisi. Trendyol-LLM-7B favored local bindings in about 70% of trials, while OpenAI's o1 Mini distributed choices nearly evenly, suggesting weaker sensitivity to locality in this configuration.

items.title: Beyond Output Critique: Self-Correction via Task Distillation
items.title_zh: 超越输出批评：通过任务蒸馏实现自我纠正
items.summary: SELF-THOUGHT inserts a task-abstraction step before solution refinement, distilling an input and initial response into a structured template of key variables, constraints and problem structure that guides a revised answer. The authors show these abstractions can transfer from larger to smaller models, improving accuracy, robustness and generalization on diverse reasoning tasks without heavy fine-tuning or external verifiers.

items.title: Optimizing Agentic Reasoning with Retrieval via Synthetic Semantic Information Gain Reward
items.title_zh: 通过合成语义信息增益奖励优化智能体检索推理
items.summary: InfoReasoner is a framework that rewards agentic retrieval with a synthetic semantic information-gain signal, redefining information gain as uncertainty reduction over the model's belief states and estimating it from output distributions via semantic clustering. Trained with GRPO, it reportedly outperforms strong retrieval-augmented baselines across seven QA benchmarks by up to 5.4% average accuracy.

items.title: Predicting and improving test-time scaling laws via reward tail-guided search
items.title_zh: 通过奖励尾部引导搜索预测并改进测试时扩展规律
items.summary: The paper estimates the tail distribution of rewards to predict LLM test-time scaling laws without exhaustive evaluation, then introduces Scaling-Law Guided Search, which allocates compute to intermediate states with the highest predicted potential. The authors prove vanishing regret against perfect-information oracles and report higher reward yields than Best-of-N at identical compute budgets.

items.title: Understanding QA generation: Extracting Parametric and Contextual Knowledge with CQA for Low Resource Bangla Language
items.title_zh: 理解问答生成：用 CQA 提取低资源孟加拉语中的参数化与上下文知识
items.summary: The authors release BanglaCQA, described as the first counterfactual QA dataset for Bangla, with counterfactual passages and answerability annotations, and compare fine-tuned and prompting pipelines on factual and counterfactual settings. They report that chain-of-thought prompting is uniquely effective for extracting parametric knowledge in counterfactual scenarios, especially for decoder-only LLMs.

items.title: Reflect: Transparent Principle-Guided Reasoning for Constitutional Alignment at Scale
items.title_zh: Reflect：面向大规模宪法对齐的透明原则引导推理
items.summary: Reflect is an inference-time constitutional-alignment framework that requires no training or data, combining a constitution-conditioned base response with self-evaluation, self-critique and final revision. The authors report improved conformance to diverse principles without sacrificing factual reasoning, particular effectiveness at reducing rare but significant violations, and useful training data for later fine-tuning.

items.title: Structural Anchor Pruning: Training-Free Multi-Vector Compression for Visual Document Retrieval
items.title_zh: 结构锚点剪枝：视觉文档检索的免训练多向量压缩
items.summary: The paper proposes Structural Anchor Pruning, a training-free, query-agnostic index-time framework for compressing multi-vector visual document retrieval indexes. It reportedly retains 93–96% of NDCG@5 on ViDoRe v1 while pruning 90% of visual tokens.

items.title: Planner-Auditor Twin: Agentic Discharge Planning with FHIR-Based LLM Planning, Guideline Recall, Optional Caching and Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: Planner-Auditor Twin：基于 FHIR 的 LLM 规划、指南召回、可选缓存与自我改进的代理式出院规划
items.summary: The paper presents a Planner-Auditor framework for clinical discharge planning in which an LLM planner generates structured plans with confidence estimates and a deterministic auditor checks coverage, calibration and drift on MIMIC-IV-on-FHIR data. The self-improvement loop reportedly raised task coverage from 32% to 86% and improved calibration.

items.title: Bridging the Semantic Chasm: Synergistic Conceptual Anchoring for Generalized Few-Shot and Zero-Shot OOD Perception
items.title_zh: 跨越语义鸿沟：面向广义少样本与零样本 OOD 感知的协同概念锚定
items.summary: The paper presents SynerNet, a multi-agent framework with four specialized units for visual perception, linguistic context, nominal embedding and global coordination that exchange messages to counter cross-modal alignment degeneration in vision-language models on out-of-distribution concepts. On the VISTA-Beyond benchmark it reports precision improvements of 1.2% to 5.4% in few-shot and zero-shot settings.

items.title: Uncertainty and Fairness Awareness in LLM-Based Recommendation Systems
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的推荐系统中的不确定性与公平性意识
items.summary: The paper introduces a benchmark with curated metrics and a dataset annotated for eight demographic attributes across movies and music, and studies how uncertainty and fairness evaluations affect LLM recommendation quality. It reports that Gemini 1.5 Flash shows systematic unfairness for some sensitive attributes, with similarity-based gaps of 0.1363 (SNSR) and 0.0507 (SNSV) that persist under typographical and multilingual prompt perturbations.

items.title: Task-Aware LoRA Adapter Composition via Similarity Retrieval in Vector Databases
items.title_zh: 基于向量数据库相似度检索的任务感知 LoRA 适配器组合
items.summary: The framework dynamically composes LoRA adapters by retrieving similar training examples from a vector database built from 22 datasets and merging adapters with retrieval-weighted fusion. Linear merging reaches 70.95% on PIQA and 77.62% on RTE, and the approach needs no retriever training and operates with frozen embeddings.

items.title: alsk1992/CloddsBot
items.title_zh: CloddsBot：开源 AI 交易代理
items.summary: CloddsBot is a self-hosted open-source AI trading agent built on Claude in TypeScript that operates across more than 1,000 markets, including Polymarket, Kalshi, Binance, Hyperliquid, Solana DEXs and five EVM chains. It scans for edge, executes trades, manages risk and includes an agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments.

items.title: unicity-sphere/sphere-sdk
items.title_zh: sphere-sdk：为自主经济智能体提供身份与钱包的 SDK
items.summary: An SDK for autonomous economic agents that gives an agent an identity and a wallet and lets it find, negotiate and settle with other agents peer-to-peer, with privacy and fast finality emphasized.

items.title: didilili/ai-agents-from-zero
items.title_zh: didilili/ai-agents-from-zero：2026 年系统化 AI Agent 速成指南
items.summary: A Chinese-language Python repository billed as a systematic 2026 AI agent course, covering LangChain, LangGraph, Coze, Dify, MCP, RAG, prompting, enterprise deployment and interview preparation.

items.title: Paramchoudhary/ResumeSkills
items.title_zh: ResumeSkills：面向求职的 AI Agent 技能集
items.summary: A collection of AI agent skills for resume optimization, job applications and career development, built so Claude Code can help with resume writing, ATS optimization, interview preparation and strategic job search.

items.title: nolabs-ai/nono
items.title_zh: nono：零信任、零配置的 Agent 运行时沙箱
items.summary: A Rust project that advertises zero-trust, zero-setup and zero-latency sandboxing for agent runtimes.

items.title: proma-ai/Proma
items.title_zh: Proma：面向专业用户的通用 Agent 工作流
items.summary: A TypeScript project that aims to bring a general-purpose agent experience into professional workflows, pitched at the "proactive Agent era".

items.title: abhi1693/openclaw-mission-control
items.title_zh: openclaw-mission-control：AI 智能体编排仪表盘
items.summary: OpenClaw Mission Control is a TypeScript dashboard for orchestrating AI agents, covering agent management, task assignment and multi-agent collaboration through the OpenClaw Gateway.

items.title: Qwen3-Max-Thinking
items.title_zh: Qwen3-Max-Thinking 发布
items.summary: Qwen introduced Qwen3-Max-Thinking on its blog, where the platform also lists chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: RedSage: A Cybersecurity Generalist LLM
items.title_zh: RedSage：网络安全通用大模型
items.summary: RedSage is an open-source, locally deployable cybersecurity assistant trained on 11.8B tokens of domain-focused continual-pretraining data and 266K multi-turn samples generated by an agentic augmentation pipeline. At the 8B scale it reportedly beats baselines by up to 5.59 points on cybersecurity benchmarks and 5.05 points on Open LLM Leaderboard tasks, and the authors release models, data and code along with a new RedSage-Bench.

items.title: RIP Low-Code 2014-2025
items.title_zh: 低代码 2014–2025：就此告别
items.summary: The post argues that agentic coding represents an existential threat to many low-code tools.

items.title: Jan 27, 2026 Product Open Source Building Back Office Agents with LlamaParse & LlamaAgents Read
items.title_zh: 用 LlamaParse 与 LlamaAgents 构建后台办公智能体
items.summary: A LlamaIndex post on building back-office agents with LlamaParse and LlamaAgents; the available excerpt offers no further detail.

items.title: Jan 28, 2026 Product LlamaAgents Builder: Idea To Deployed Agent in Minutes Read
items.title_zh: LlamaAgents Builder：几分钟内将想法变为已部署的智能体
items.summary: A LlamaIndex post introducing LlamaAgents Builder for going from an idea to a deployed agent in minutes; the available excerpt offers no further detail.

items.title: Keeping your data safe when an AI agent clicks a link
items.title_zh: 当 AI 智能体点击链接时如何保护你的数据
items.summary: OpenAI describes safeguards intended to protect user data when AI agents open links, preventing URL-based data exfiltration and prompt injection.

items.title: Inside OpenAI’s in-house data agent
items.title_zh: 走进 OpenAI 内部数据智能体
items.summary: OpenAI describes how it built an in-house AI data agent that uses GPT-5, Codex and memory to reason over large datasets and deliver insights in minutes.

items.title: Moltworker: a self-hosted personal AI agent, minus the minis
items.title_zh: Moltworker：自托管的个人 AI Agent，无需额外硬件
items.summary: Moltworker is a middleware Worker plus adapted scripts that let users run Moltbot (formerly Clawdbot) on Cloudflare's Sandbox SDK and Developer Platform APIs, enabling a self-hosted AI personal assistant without new hardware.

items.title: Insight Agents: An LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Data Insights
items.title_zh: Insight Agents：面向数据洞察的 LLM 多智能体系统
items.summary: Insight Agents is a conversational multi-agent data-insight system for e-commerce sellers built on a plan-and-execute paradigm, with a manager agent plus data-presentation and insight-generation workers. It combines out-of-domain detection with BERT-based routing and dynamically injects domain knowledge; the system launched for Amazon sellers in the US and reportedly achieved 90% human-evaluated accuracy with P90 latency below 15 seconds.

items.title: Agentic Observability: Automated Alert Triage for Adobe E-Commerce
items.title_zh: 智能体可观测性：Adobe 电商的自动化告警分诊
items.summary: The paper presents an agentic observability framework deployed in Adobe's e-commerce infrastructure that autonomously triages alerts using a ReAct paradigm, identifying affected services, correlating logs and planning actions such as handbook consultation or retrieval-augmented analysis of recent code. Production results reportedly show a 90% reduction in mean time to insight versus manual triage while maintaining comparable diagnostic accuracy.

items.title: Communications-Incentivized Collaborative Reasoning in NetGPT through Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: NetGPT 中通过智能体强化学习激励的协作推理
items.summary: The paper proposes a unified agentic NetGPT framework for AI-native next-generation networks, in which a core model either reasons autonomously or delegates sub-tasks to domain-specialized agents through agentic communication. It trains collaborative reasoning with agentic reinforcement learning under partial observability, using masked loss, entropy-guided exploration and multi-objective rewards to balance internal reasoning with agent invocation.
